requirements.statement: All nine canonical scenarios execute with native MAF workflow and checkpoint behavior, authorized decisions, idempotent effects, and restart recovery.
requirements.success_criteria: Every canonical technical_execution result exactly matches the versioned golden case.
requirements.failure_criteria: Any technical result is missing, malformed, duplicated, below threshold, or differs from the canonical case.

checks.procedure: Execute ORS-001 through ORS-009 through the generated API, native MAF host/checkpoints, PostgreSQL stores, and crash worker; normalize with native MAF evaluation.

requirements.statement: All nine canonical scenarios produce the exact deterministic Order Resolution business outcomes.
requirements.success_criteria: Every business_outcome result exactly matches order-resolution-spec/0.1.0.
requirements.failure_criteria: Any proposal, approval, action, error, or terminal state differs from the canonical case.

checks.procedure: Compare generated application observations with the canonical golden business outcomes through native MAF LocalEvaluator checks.

requirements.statement: Any configured real model explanation meets a declared quality rubric without changing deterministic business authority.
requirements.success_criteria: An explicitly configured provider evaluation meets its declared threshold.
requirements.failure_criteria: The configured evaluation fails, is malformed, or falls below threshold.

checks.procedure: Run a real configured provider/model evaluation; do not substitute deterministic fixture output.

requirements.statement: The generated Order Resolution interface is exercised through an actual browser.
requirements.success_criteria: Browser evidence demonstrates the intended authenticated user journey.
requirements.failure_criteria: The browser journey fails or contradicts the recorded application state.

checks.procedure: Run the generated UI through an actual browser and retain the result artifact.

requirements.statement: Readiness evidence is revision-bound and attested by an independently trusted producer.
requirements.success_criteria: Evidence digests, revision, environment, and producer attestation validate against the independent trust root.
requirements.failure_criteria: Evidence is stale, mismatched, altered, unsigned, self-attested, or from an untrusted producer.

checks.procedure: Validate revision-bound evidence and a scoped producer attestation against an independently administered trust root.
